from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperReference(BaseModel):
    """One parsed paper documenting which other provided papers it references."""
    source_paper_title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper currently being parsed")
    references_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers (from the known collection) found in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers_references: list[PaperReference]
